title: Project Ascent: One Personalized Career Advisor
content:

title: GPS-Based Geofencing System
content:
Deep-diving into hardware and IoT integration! Successfully designed, developed, and implemented a real-time GPS geofencing system using microcontroller hardware and reliable IoT communication protocols to track boundary alerts precisely.
